name: Nelson Lyle

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single large primary residence with a brown shingle roof and irregular building footprint|A wide concrete driveway and parking area is located along the right side of the house|A smaller detached structure is situated near the main building|The lot includes landscaped areas with trees, shrubs, rock features, and some flowering plants, particularly along the perimeter and front yard areas|Vegetation lines the sides and rear of the main residence.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence features a covered entry area with multiple windows visible along the facade|A large concrete driveway provides vehicle access|Dense hedging runs along the front of the property, with mature trees located on both the left and right sides of the structure|A small structure is visible in front of the house|Vegetation lines the front of the house, with large trees to the rear of the residence.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows significant mature tree coverage and landscaping immediately adjacent to the building|Rock features and vegetation are visible along this elevation|Limited building openings are present on this side of the structure|Large mature trees cover the left side of the house.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence includes a paved area|Some equipment and storage items are visible on the ground near the building, with several items leaning against the house|Mature trees and landscaping border the rear of the property|A walkway runs along the length of the rear|Small windows are visible|The back of the house and property is lined with small trees and bushes.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows two garage doors and a concrete driveway|Dense trees and landscaping are present on both sides of the driveway|A portion of another structure is visible near the edge of the image|Lines of small trees and bushes line the front and rear of the house|The sidewalk along the rear of the house stops at a fence, roughly level with the back of the garage.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a wide concrete driveway that supports circulation along the right side of the house and into the parking area. Parking space is available adjacent to the structure. Dense tree coverage and landscaping along multiple sides of the building may limit visibility and movement in those areas. The rear of the property appears accessible via the driveway. Equipment and items stored near the rear of the house, some leaning against the building, may affect clear movement in that area. A walkway runs along the rear of the house.
